applicant_context.applicant_summary: Home A-level school-leaver meeting Brunel's represented GCSE and A-level gates with UCAT 1800/2700 and SJT Band 2.

evidence_gaps: International non-UCAT review has no executable numerical formula.

Scottish, Access to HE and BTEC routes are not verified.

stage_1_checks.label: GCSE gate
stage_1_checks.requirement: At least five GCSEs at Grade 6/B or above, English Language Grade 4/C, Mathematics Grade 5, and two sciences at Grade 6/B.
stage_1_checks.applicant_value: Five GCSEs at Grade 6 including English Language, Mathematics, Biology, Chemistry and Physics.

stage_1_checks.label: A-level gate
stage_1_checks.requirement: AAA including Chemistry or Biology and a second science from Chemistry, Biology, Physics or Mathematics.
stage_1_checks.applicant_value: AAA in Biology, Chemistry and Mathematics.

stage_1_checks.label: UCAT ranking input
stage_1_checks.requirement: Eligible Home applicants are ranked by total UCAT score. Brunel does not publish a fixed future UCAT cut-off.

stage_1_checks.label: SJT gate
stage_1_checks.requirement: SJT Bands 1-3 are accepted; Band 4 is rejected.
